Buy Ruthless Sevad's silence by delivering a private message.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* Must have talked to Ruthless Sevad before bringing the supplies to [[Elder Jonah]].

===Objectives===
* Bring [[Janeera]] the message from Ruthless Sevad.
* See Ruthless Sevad for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Kournan Coin]]

==Walkthrough==
Nice and easy.  Map to the [[Sunspear Sanctuary]] and walk out into the [[Marga Coast]], where Janeera is waiting in [[Ronjok]] village just outside.  After speaking to Janeera, map to [[Camp Hojanu]] and return to Ruthless Sevad in the Barbarous Shore.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Ruthless Sevad'''
:''"Okay, if you want to keep me quiet about your presence, Sunspear, just do a simple job for me. I need this '''message''' delivered to '''Janeera''', a village healer on the '''Marga Coast'''. It bears my personal seal, so don't open it! It's my business, not yours...and the healer will let me know if the seal is broken. Get that message to her and you've bought my silence."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Consider it done.
|decline = There are other ways to silence you. Close your eyes and I'll show you one.
|ask = You vex me.... '''Message'''. '''Janeera'''. '''Ronjok'''. You got that? Otherwise, I go straight to the Kournans. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Janeera'''
:''"From Sevad, you say? I wonder what he wants. I'm almost frightened to open it! Hmmmm...what does it say? That's none of your business, but thank you for delivering it unopened."''

:''"You can go now. I'm a busy healer, you know."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Ruthless Sevad'''
:''"Janeera received the message? Good. How did she look? Did she...? Nevermind. I don't want to know. You did this task for me, so your secret is safe...for now."''

==Notes==
*Since this quest is picked up during one of the steps of [[A Question of Morality]], Janeera can be very easily spoken to when you come to complete the latter quest.
